issues.title: [Android] Transparency take two
issues.body: I did miss a spot here...

issues.title: [Android] Made PNGs keep transparency through cropping.
issues.body:
Previously, when a PNG was cropped on Android (as in the case of avatar or server icon selection), the transparency was replaced with black. That's because during the resize step, we were compressing all images as jpgs.

Fix: pass in the mimetype, use the png compression format if it's a png. keep using jpg for everything else.

note: this PR is broken in a vacuum. it also needs https://github.com/discord/react-native-image-crop-picker/pull/5 to function properly.

issues.title: [RNA][Images] Fixing permissions issue
issues.body:
Fixing an issue where images weren't able to upload for any Android 10 devices. This was because the `supportedPermissions` list by default included `Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE`, which was only removed for version codes above Q (Android 10). Since we don't include the external storage permission by [default](https://github.com/discord/discord/blob/main/discord_android_rn/android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml#L29) for Android 10, this will always throw an exception.

Asana: https://app.asana.com/0/1200546912788443/1201897631252202/f

issues.title: [iOS] Return png image if specified mimeType is 'image/png'
issues.body: This PR is to fix the issue for cropping images with transparent background. Previously the lib always compress image as jpeg so we can't keep the background. This pr returns png image if the specified `mimeType` is `image/png`.
